4. Design Tokens & Color Palette Stylesheet

static/css/tokens.css

CSS Custom Properties declaring the design system: neutral surface values, category accents (hospital, shelter, water, food), elevation drop-shadows, and typography scales.

💻 Full Source Code: static/css/tokens.css
:root {
  /* Color Palette - Neutrals */
  --bg-app: #0f172a;
  --bg-surface: #ffffff;
  --bg-surface-elevated: #f8fafc;
  --bg-surface-subtle: #f1f5f9;
  --bg-overlay: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.65);

  --border-subtle: #e2e8f0;
  --border-strong: #cbd5e1;
  --border-focus: #2563eb;

  --text-primary: #0f172a;
  --text-secondary: #475569;
  --text-muted: #64748b;
  --text-inverse: #ffffff;

  /* Accent Colors */
  --color-primary: #2563eb;
  --color-primary-hover: #1d4ed8;
  --color-primary-light: #eff6ff;

  --color-danger: #dc2626;
  --color-danger-light: #fef2f2;
  --color-danger-border: #fecaca;
  --color-warning: #d97706;
  --color-warning-light: #fffbeb;
  --color-warning-border: #fde68a;
  --color-success: #16a34a;
  --color-success-light: #f0fdf4;
  --color-info: #0284c7;
  --color-info-light: #f0f9ff;

  /* Category Specific Colors */
  --cat-hospital: #e11d48;
  --cat-hospital-bg: #ffe4e6;
  --cat-clinic: #0d9488;
  --cat-clinic-bg: #ccfbf1;
  --cat-pharmacy: #059669;
  --cat-pharmacy-bg: #d1fae5;
  --cat-police: #2563eb;
  --cat-police-bg: #dbeafe;
  --cat-fire: #ea580c;
  --cat-fire-bg: #ffedd5;
  --cat-shelter: #d97706;
  --cat-shelter-bg: #fef3c7;
  --cat-water: #0284c7;
  --cat-water-bg: #e0f2fe;
  --cat-food: #7c3aed;
  --cat-food-bg: #ede9fe;
  --cat-toilet: #6366f1;
  --cat-toilet-bg: #e0e7ff;

  /* Elevation Shadows */
  --shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
  --shadow-md: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1), 0 2px 4px -2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
  --shadow-lg: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1), 0 4px 6px -4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
  --shadow-floating: 0 14px 28px rgba(0,0,0,0.18), 0 10px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.12);

  /* Typography */
  --font-sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
  --font-mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace;

  --text-xs: 0.75rem;     /* 12px */
  --text-sm: 0.844rem;    /* 13.5px */
  --text-base: 0.938rem;  /* 15px */
  --text-lg: 1.063rem;    /* 17px */
  --text-xl: 1.25rem;     /* 20px */
  --text-2xl: 1.5rem;     /* 24px */

  /* Radii */
  --radius-sm: 6px;
  --radius-md: 10px;
  --radius-lg: 16px;
  --radius-full: 9999px;

  /* Transitions */
  --transition-fast: 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
  --transition-normal: 250ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
  --transition-spring: 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);

  /* Layout dimensions */
  --sidebar-width: 400px;
  --header-height: 64px;
  --touch-target-min: 44px;
  --z-map: 1;
  --z-floating-search: 1000;
  --z-sidebar: 1010;
  --z-bottom-sheet: 1020;
  --z-modal: 1050;
  --z-disclaimer: 1060;
  --z-toast: 1070;
}

/* Reduced motion preference */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *, *::before, *::after {
    animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
    animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
    transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
    scroll-behavior: auto !important;
  }
}

5. Layout Structure & Responsive Grid Stylesheet

static/css/layout.css

Styles governing viewport containment, fullscreen Leaflet map positioning, floating command island, top search bar wrapper, and responsive breakpoint adjustments.

💻 Source Code (Excerpt): static/css/layout.css
/* Base reset and layout */
*, *::before, *::after {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

html, body {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  overflow: hidden;
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  font-size: 16px;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  background-color: var(--bg-app);
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
}

button, input, select, textarea {
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: inherit;
}

a {
  color: var(--color-primary);
  text-decoration: none;
}
a:hover {
  text-decoration: underline;
}

:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--border-focus);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

/* App container */
.app-container {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  display: flex;
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* Fullscreen Map */
#map {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  z-index: var(--z-map);
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  background-color: #e5e3df;
}

/* Floating Top Bar (Search + Quick Actions) */
.floating-topbar {
  position: absolute;
  top: 14px;
  left: 14px;
  right: 14px;
  max-width: 680px;
  z-index: var(--z-floating-search);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
  pointer-events: none; /* children enable pointer events */
}

.search-box-wrapper {
  pointer-events: auto;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  padding: 4px 8px;
  gap: 6px;
  transition: box-shadow var(--transition-fast), border-color var(--transition-fast);
}

.search-box-wrapper:focus-within {
  border-color: var(--color-primary);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-floating);
}

.search-icon-btn,
.search-action-btn {
  background: none;
  border: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 40px;
  height: 40px;
  min-width: 40px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  transition: background-color var(--transition-fast), color var(--transition-fast);
}

/* Component Styles */

/* 1. Category Filter Chips */
.category-chip {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  padding: 6px 12px;
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  cursor: pointer;
  white-space: nowrap;
  user-select: none;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  transition: all var(--transition-fast);
  min-height: 34px;
}

.category-chip:hover {
  border-color: var(--border-strong);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  background-color: var(--bg-surface-elevated);
}

.category-chip.active {
  background: var(--text-primary);
  color: var(--text-inverse);
  border-color: var(--text-primary);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
}

.category-chip .chip-dot {
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
}

/* Category specific chip dot colors */
.category-chip[data-category="hospital"] .chip-dot { background-color: var(--cat-hospital); }
.category-chip[data-category="clinic"] .chip-dot { background-color: var(--cat-clinic); }
.category-chip[data-category="pharmacy"] .chip-dot { background-color: var(--cat-pharmacy); }
.category-chip[data-category="police"] .chip-dot { background-color: var(--cat-police); }
.category-chip[data-category="fire_station"] .chip-dot { background-color: var(--cat-fire); }
.category-chip[data-category="shelter"] .chip-dot { background-color: var(--cat-shelter); }
.category-chip[data-category="drinking_water"] .chip-dot { background-color: var(--cat-water); }
.category-chip[data-category="food_bank"] .chip-dot { background-color: var(--cat-food); }
.category-chip[data-category="toilets"] .chip-dot { background-color: var(--cat-toilet); }

/* 2. Emergency Notice Banner */
.emergency-disclaimer-banner {
  background: var(--color-warning-light);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-warning-border);
  padding: 8px 12px;
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  color: #78350f;
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 8px;
  line-height: 1.4;
}

7. Draggable Bottom Sheet & Detail Drawer Stylesheet

static/css/bottom-sheet.css

CSS specifications for mobile draggable bottom sheets: handle bar styling, summary row, touch-action configuration, and expansion states (peek, half, full).

💻 Full Source Code: static/css/bottom-sheet.css
/* Mobile Draggable Bottom Sheet */

.bottom-sheet-container {
  display: none;
}

@media (max-width: 899px) {
  .bottom-sheet-container {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    position: fixed;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    height: 90vh;
    background: var(--bg-surface);
    border-top-left-radius: 20px;
    border-top-right-radius: 20px;
    box-shadow: 0 -8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
    z-index: var(--z-bottom-sheet);
    transform: translateY(calc(100% - 76px)); /* Peek height */
    transition: transform 0.28s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.9, 0.3, 1);
    will-change: transform;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .bottom-sheet-container.dragging {
    transition: none; /* No transition while user fingers are dragging */
  }

  .bottom-sheet-container.state-peek {
    transform: translateY(calc(100% - 76px));
  }

  .bottom-sheet-container.state-half {
    transform: translateY(48%);
  }

  .bottom-sheet-container.state-full {
    transform: translateY(6%);
  }

  /* Sheet Drag Handle Area */
  .bottom-sheet-handle-area {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 10px 0 6px 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    cursor: grab;
    user-select: none;
    touch-action: none; /* Crucial for custom pointer/touch drag */
    background: var(--bg-surface);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  }

  .bottom-sheet-handle-bar {
    width: 44px;
    height: 5px;
    background: var(--border-strong);
    border-radius: var(--radius-full);
    margin-bottom: 6px;
  }

  .bottom-sheet-summary-row {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 0 16px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    font-size: var(--text-sm);
    font-weight: 600;
  }

  .sheet-title-text {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    color: var(--text-primary);
  }

  .sheet-chevron {
    color: var(--text-muted);
    transition: transform var(--transition-fast);
  }

  .bottom-sheet-container.state-full .sheet-chevron {
    transform: rotate(180deg);
  }

  /* Sheet Content Scroll Area */
  .bottom-sheet-content {
    flex: 1;
    overflow-y: auto;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
    padding: 8px 12px 28px 12px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 8px;
  }

  /* Backdrop scrim when sheet is expanded to full */
  .bottom-sheet-backdrop {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.4);
    z-index: calc(var(--z-bottom-sheet) - 1);
    opacity: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    transition: opacity 0.28s ease;
  }

  .bottom-sheet-backdrop.active {
    opacity: 1;
    pointer-events: auto;
  }
}
